comment: Default grip per held kind (#458): socket, then position (blocks), rotation (XYZ Euler degrees) and uniform scale in that socket's frame, applied to the object's canonical held frame (sprite: centred, one unit across, the image's bottom-left-to-top-right diagonal along +Y, its front facing +Z; block: unit cube on the origin; model: its hand transform). The player model faces -Z with its right hand at +X; at rest the grip sockets carry the model axes. An object's SBO 'held' record overrides its kind's grip.
